backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all backend state (comment lists, app events, chat messages, images, settings, withdrawals, pricing) and exposing CRUD/query endpoints for the app. Includes mixins for blob storage and authorization, plus type definitions for all domain entities.
backend/migration.mo: Motoko migration module that upgrades actor state from OldActor to NewActor by adding a default `countdownState` field with inactive/null values.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-generated JSON summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key behaviors of every component, hook, and view in the frontend.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, card, primary, chart, and sidebar color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell that mounts the React app into a `#root` div and loads the TypeScript entry point `src/main.tsx`.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component rendering the full app with a tabbed layout (Comment, Live, Upload, Admin), a countdown timer, background music toggle, and floating shape decorations — no authentication gate.
frontend/src/components/AdminUnlock.tsx: Admin unlock screen component that checks localStorage for a stored admin code and calls `useAdminAuth` to validate entry, auto-skipping the lock screen if already authenticated.
frontend/src/components/BulkCommentGener: A React component that lets users select a comment list, enter an access key, and generate multiple comments in bulk, then copy them to clipboard while decrementing inventory.
frontend/src/components/MetricsDonutChar: An SVG donut chart component that visualizes the percentage of used vs. total templates with a gradient arc and centered percentage label.
frontend/src/components/TopDownShooter.t: A canvas-based top-down shooter mini-game where the player moves with keyboard input and shoots at enemies by clicking, tracking score and time.
frontend/src/components/UploadComment.ts: A form component that allows users to type and submit a comment via the addChatMessage mutation, showing loading, success, and error states.
A modal dialog that displays a user's earnings and collects a 10-digit wallet number to submit a withdrawal request via mutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: A hook that manages admin authentication state using a hardcoded code, persisting unlock status in localStorage and exposing unlock/lock functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: A hook that manages an HTML Audio element for background music, supporting play/pause control based on a URL and enabled flag.
frontend/src/hooks/useClaimedComments.ts: A hook that stores and retrieves per-device claimed comments in localStorage, keyed by device ID and list ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: Provides a hook with `generate` and `generateBulk` functions that randomly pick templates from a `CommentList`, optionally appending a suffix or symbol.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdown.ts: A hook that returns a live countdown (hours, minutes, seconds) to midnight, updating every second via `setInterval`.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceId.ts: A hook that retrieves or generates a persistent UUID device ID stored in `localStorage`.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` and `useInternetIdentity` hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for interacting with the backend actor, covering comment lists, events, chat, images, settings, earnings, and more.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind, and defines CSS custom properties and component classes for a dark sci-fi/glassmorphism design system with gold and teal accents.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped in `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/utils/liveListParser.ts: Parses a structured text report into app entries with usernames and dates, using regex to identify date lines, app name blocks (wrapped in asterisks), and numbered username lines.
frontend/src/utils/templateGenerator.ts: Generates randomized app review comment templates by combining tone-specific adjectives and phrase pools across categories (performance, UI, features, support) with configurable length suffixes.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist, retrieve, and clear those values using sessionStorage.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminAITemplate: An admin view that generates comment templates locally based on a topic, tone, count, and optional appended symbol, then allows selecting and bulk-adding them to a chosen comment list.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminChat.tsx: Admin chat panel that displays chat messages fetched from the backend and allows sending new messages via a form with auto-scroll to the latest message.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminComments.t: Admin UI for managing comment lists, including creating, renaming, deleting, locking/unlocking lists, adding templates, and setting inventory counts with metrics visualization.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminEarnings.t: Admin earnings dashboard that displays summary stats (total apps, entries, earnings) and a per-app breakdown table, with a manual refresh button.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminImages.tsx: Admin image management panel that allows uploading images with a name and comma-separated tags, showing a preview before upload and listing existing images.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminLiveList.t: Admin panel for managing live app/event lists, supporting creating/deleting events, bulk username uploads, file imports, and auto-parsing of live list reports.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminPricing.ts: Admin UI for managing per-app price entries, supporting add, edit, delete, and CSV bulk upload operations via React Query mutations.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings panel for managing the access key (view, set, regenerate) and background music (toggle enable/disable, upload audio file).
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminView.tsx: Top-level admin panel component that gates access behind authentication and renders tabbed navigation across all admin sub-views (comments, pricing, earnings, settings, etc.).
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminWithdrawal: Read-only admin view that lists all user withdrawal requests grouped by status (pending, approved, rejected) with summary stats and a refresh button.
frontend/src/views/LiveChecker.tsx: A view that lets users check one or multiple usernames against live app event lists, displaying match positions and prices, and optionally showing a withdrawal modal when earnings are found.
frontend/src/views/UploadView.tsx: A view providing three upload sections: a single comment uploader, a bulk comment generator component, and a file-based bulk comment uploader that adds templates to a selected comment list.
frontend/src/views/UserView.tsx: A user-facing view where visitors select a comment list, claim a unique comment (persisted in localStorage per device), and copy it to the clipboard, with a mini game component also embedded.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts (Orbitron, Rajdhani), OKLCH-based color tokens, glass/glow box shadows, and keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the app as a Content & Feedback Manager with pending feature requests for Internet Identity admin auth, background music, countdown timer, and light/dark mode toggle.
